scene: The snail bus terminal connects three brightly lit transit hubs.
picture: Flat side view inside the spacious park bus depot. On the far left, a docked harbour ferry rocks beside a low wooden pier. Centre left, the player in her yellow raincoat stands near the driver. Up high in the centre, a glass cable car hangs from a steel pylon. On the far right, an open subway stairwell glows.
